name: ContinuationEditor

test_list.description: The read-only revision advances after cursor movement, edits, and undo.
Selected text replacement and undo preserve the exact prior selection.
Word navigation/deletion preserve grapheme boundaries and atomic chips.
Line and document navigation differ and extend selections.
Double-click selection expands Unicode words, whitespace runs, punctuation graphemes, and atomic chips.
Geometry covers tabs, Unicode widths, chips, newline and exact-width wraps.
Vertical motion keeps desired column and mouse mapping returns legal boundaries.

output_type: editor state transitions and byte/cell mapping
output_description: Selection editing and shared wrapped geometry.
